The contents of this package:
- pluto.exe: Standalone script runtime.
- plutoc.exe: Source-to-bytecode compiler.
For advanced users:
- libpluto.dll: For applications using Pluto as a dynamic library with default configuration. May also be used as a "drop in & rename" replacement for a Lua DLL.
For developers:
- libpluto.lib: To dynamically link against libpluto.dll.
- libplutostatic.a: To statically link in Pluto with default configuration.
